searchText: hey <@!340345049063882753>, I was toying around with `curl` and the REST block api endpoints and gave it an `Accept: application/octet-stream,application/json;q=0.9` - this should in theory select SSZ, but I'm getting json instead from infura - is that a teku thing or an infura thing? `Accept: application/octet-stream` gives SSZ for example, `Accept: application/octet-stream;q=1` gives JSON Probably a teku thing. I think we’re doing a pretty simple match on the accept field. Not sure if that’s our fault or the library off the top of my head. If you could log an issue that would be great and we’ll see what we can do.
